people.name: Eden
people.line: The perfect garden where God placed Adam and Eve.

translations.web: Yahweh God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
translations.bsb: Then the LORD God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
translations.kjv: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep
translations.asv: And Jehovah God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
